name: Shinseiki Ijitte Princess Next 3 ~Mazoku Hime Labis Kourin!~
original_name: 新世紀いじってプリンセスNEXT3～魔族姫ラビス降臨！～
source:
Sin and Toto visit Tyron to take part in the cease-fire ceremony. Everything goes well and the war between Tyron and Caseri ends. But Labis, princess of Caseri, falls in love with Sin. Like this, another war between Toto and Labis begins now....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081223023142/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011773]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
辛与托托前往泰隆，参加停战典礼。仪式一切顺利，泰隆与卡塞利之间的战争宣告结束。然而，卡塞利的公主拉比丝却爱上了辛。就这样，托托与拉比丝之间的另一场战争如今拉开了序幕……

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081223023142/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011773]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
